threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You can spot the newbies by their confused looks when the evening bus doesn't show up. We all know it's just part of the Dalston charm.
Caught a night bus from Brixton and a guy dressed as a dinosaur was having a full debate with a pigeon about the best takeaway. Only in London.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: I knew I was home when the kebab guy on Hermannstraße remembered my usual order, and insisted I try his new spicy sauce. That felt like family.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Friedrichshain can you catch spontaneous techno parties in public parks, complete with improvised sound systems and eclectic crowds. It’s a vibe.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: Only real locals instinctively know to avoid the Civic Center during a BART meltdown. It’s like a secret survival guide around here.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Just saw a guy with a pet iguana on the 38 Geary. It was a perfect encapsulation of the Tenderloin vibe – surreal yet completely normal.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think the parks are just for lounging. Locals know those plazas are for impromptu concerts and daily debates on life.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell by how they still call it ‘la Sagrada Familia’ instead of just ‘Sagrada’—locals skip the ‘la’ unless they want to flex their Español.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think 'the bus' means the number 38, not the 48 or the night buses that keep you awake after 1am.
Caught the 333 last night; a guy serenaded the whole bus with 90s R&B. Only in Brixton would the driver join in and the passengers clap along.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I saw a group of kids building a massive sandcastle in the middle of the street while the traffic just flowed around them.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: You ever notice the spontaneous street performances at Görlitzer Park? It's like an unfiltered slice of life, always something unexpected happening.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone’s from the Mission if they can spot a taco truck from three blocks away, even buried behind construction.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy on the 31 mixing tracks with his beatbox while the driver took a breather. Classic SF: even the commute has a soundtrack.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think 'Gràcia' is just the square; they miss the hidden murals and the tiny plazas where locals sip coffee, away from the crowds.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a new arrival by their confusion over the 3-hour lunch siesta—watch them try to order food at 4 PM.
